notes.title: Kozyrev Horrors - Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
This patch brings several enhancements aimed at improving the overall quality of gameplay:

[list]
[*][b]AI Improvements: [/b]The alien's behavior has been fine-tuned, making it more unpredictable. The creature now reacts more dynamically in the dark, and its jumpscares have been revamped to add a new layer of tension.
[*][b]Object Interaction: [/b]We’ve improved the interaction system, making it more precise and responsive. 
[*][b]Audio Updates: [/b]We’ve introduced new atmospheric sound effects and reworked the music to reflect the game's growing intensity, making every moment feel more immersive and haunting.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Various bugs, including interaction issues with the padlock and visual elements, have been resolved for a more stable and fluid experience.
[/list]

Thank you all for your invaluable feedback and continued support as we work to refine the game!

notes.title: Kozyrev Horrors - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Kozyrev Horrors - Patch 1.1.0[/b][/h1]

[h3]Thank you for your support![/h3]
Over the past few days, we've focused on addressing several key bugs reported by players. We appreciate your patience and feedback, and we’re committed to continuing to improve the game. Below are the major fixes included in this patch:

[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bugs causing issues with padlock interactions.
[*]Improved the reliability of control inputs, including gamepad and keyboard focus.
[*]Adjusted and fixed various audio issues to enhance the experience.
[*]Addressed problems with sequence skipping and scene transitions.
[*]Made adjustments to game balance, including flashlight usage and enemy encounters.
[*]Fixed several interaction issues with in-game objects and sequences.
[*]Resolved crashes and game-breaking bugs in specific scenes.
[/list]

Thank you again for your ongoing support! We are working on more updates and improvements, so stay tuned for future patches.
